body:
Closes #311

## 🎯 Goal
- Remove the two `AppearancePayload` fields that have had no reader since #308, now that the one-release population window `BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.md` §2 requires has passed.

## What Changed
- `src/routes/_app/-server/settings.ts`: `AppearancePayload.mapStyle` (the merged value) and `AppearancePayload.workspaceMapStyle` are deleted, and `loadAppearance` stops populating them. With `orgRow` no longer used, `loadAppearance` reads only `ensureUserSettings` — one fewer query per `/settings/appearance` load. The doc comment on `mapStyleOverride` no longer links to the deleted fields; its reasoning (why the raw column is needed) is kept.
- `.ai/specs/implemented/2026-09-07-basemap-catalogue.md`: a note beside the `mapStyleOverride` paragraph records that the two fields were retired, so the spec does not describe a shape that no longer exists.

## Release gate (the issue's "confirm first")
- #308's merge commit `95e05a2a` is an ancestor of `157c6157`, the head of the successful `deploy.yml` production run of 2026-09-14, and of every production deploy since. The previous bundle in the field during this PR's deploy window has not read either field since then.
- Reader search right before landing: `grep -rn "workspaceMapStyle" src e2e` → only the deleted lines; every other `.mapStyle` in `src/`/`e2e/` is `ShellPayload.mapStyle`, `getEffectiveSettings(...).mapStyle`, a settings row or a `saveAppearance`/Zod input — none reads the `loadAppearance` payload. `appearance.tsx` reads `data.mapStyleOverride` only.

## 🧪 Tests
- `node .ai/scripts/agent-kit-check.mjs` — 51 managed files match the lock.
- `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` — clean.
- `pnpm test` — 6408 passed / 277 files.
- `bash .ai/scripts/check-generated.sh` — generated files are current (run with a short `TMPDIR`; the cezar worktree's default path is too long for tsx's IPC socket, an environment issue unrelated to this diff).
- `pnpm build` — built; 146 server functions registered, every reference resolves.
- No new test: this is a deletion of fields with no reader, and the type checker is what proves nothing reads them.

## 💥 Breaking Changes
- Removes two fields from a server-function output. Permitted by `BACKWARD_COMPATIBILITY.md` §2 after the one-release population window, which is verified above. No input, route, schema or migration changes.

## Definition of done (docs/SPEC.md §7)

- [x] `pnpm build` succeeds
- [x] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` clean, no new suppressions
- [x] New logic has tests; `pnpm test` passes (no new logic — a deletion)
- [ ] Visually verified in a browser: light and dark, desktop and mobile (UI changes) — no visual change; the QA step covers `/settings/appearance`
- [x] No TODOs, placeholder copy, `console.log` or commented-out code
- [x] Only files the issue or spec names were touched
- [x] User-facing copy landed in all 23 locales (`i18n-messages`) — no copy changed

## Noticed but not touching

nothing
title: refactor(settings): retire the orphaned AppearancePayload map-style fields (#311)
